metadata.description: Ask Pope Shenouda and Ask the Church Fathers

plugins.name: ask-pope-shenouda
plugins.description: Ask Pope Shenouda III (اسأل البابا شنوده): your spiritual and Bible questions answered with clips of his own recorded lectures, as in the Pope Shenouda app: video and audio parts with exact time ranges, Arabic captions, English subtitles and dub where available, and links to open the answer on the web and in the Android app.

plugins.name: ask-church-fathers
plugins.description: Ask the Church Fathers (اسأل آباء الكنيسة): your Bible and spiritual questions answered with clips of recorded sermons and lectures by Coptic Orthodox fathers and teachers, as in the CopticBible app: video and audio parts with exact time ranges, Bible references, Arabic captions, English subtitles and dub where available, and links to the web and the Android app.
